ModMetaData.name: JB Framework
ModMetaData.author: Julius Berger
ModMetaData.description:
The shared foundation of the RimWorld mods by Julius Berger. It adds nothing to your game by itself: no items, no buildings, no events. Mods that need it list it as a dependency, and Steam installs it for you.
What it gives those mods: - the settings window from Hearth and Harbor: sidebar, search, presets, areas you can switch off as a whole, values per save - error fences: when one feature of one mod keeps failing, only that feature pauses, the game keeps running and tells you - a diagnosis report you can copy into a bug report (no personal paths) - a Compatibility page that says which DLCs and mods were detected
Mod settings, JB Framework: every mod that uses it, their versions, which areas are on, patches that failed, one combined report, and the window size, detailed log and welcome cards for all of them.
Built and tested on RimWorld 1.7. The 1.6 build is best effort and untested.
For modders: MIT licence. A stable public API (additive only), XML docs and a sample mod.
